title: A Mountain Adventure
text:
Last summer, Mia went on an adventure in the mountains of Turkey. She walked for five hours with a guide named Ali. They saw a beautiful waterfall and ate lunch by a river.

On the second day, the weather became cold and windy, so Mia wore her warm jacket. She was tired, but she felt very happy at the top of the mountain. Before she went home, she took many photos to remember the trip.

questions.text: How long did Mia walk with her guide?
What did Mia wear on the second day?

options: She wanted to remember the trip
She was looking for a job
She needed to pay the guide
She was lost on the road

vocabulary.definition: a person who shows other people around a place
water that falls from a high place over rocks
when there is a lot of moving air outside
to keep something in your mind so you can think about it later

paragraph_translations: Geçen yaz Mia, Türkiye'nin dağlarında bir maceraya çıktı. Ali adında bir rehberle beş saat yürüdü. Güzel bir şelale gördüler ve bir nehrin kenarında öğle yemeği yediler.
İkinci gün hava soğuk ve rüzgarlı oldu, bu yüzden Mia sıcak ceketini giydi. Yorgundu ama dağın zirvesinde çok mutluydu. Eve dönmeden önce gezisini hatırlamak için çok fotoğraf çekti.
